metadata.title: Statics Protocol
metadata.description: Statics unifies static multi-asset baskets, position-owned finance, and protocol-owned liquidity with a native dollar.
metadata.socialDescription: Static assets. Static rules. Dynamic markets. Own your position.

navigation.returnLanding: Return to Statics Protocol landing page

overview.label: Overview
overview.title: Your portfolio
overview.description: Everything you hold in one place: your Dollar balance, positions, collateral, and rewards waiting to be claimed.

dollar.label: Dollar
dollar.title: Get Statics Dollar
dollar.description: Deposit ETH to receive Dollar, or convert your Dollar and risk shares back into ETH. You will see the exact amounts before you confirm.

wallet.label: Wallet
wallet.title: Your wallet
wallet.description: Check your balances, add funds, send assets, and move money in and out of Statics.

faucet.label: Faucet
faucet.title: Get testnet assets
faucet.description: Claim the fixtures used by Statics or open Robinhood's faucet for more testnet ETH and stock tokens.

portal.label: Add funds
portal.title: Add funds to Statics
portal.description: Bring money in from another network or another token. Swap, bridge, or convert to Statics Dollar.

baskets.label: Baskets
baskets.title: Baskets
baskets.description: Buy or sell a fixed bundle of assets as one unit. You will see exactly what a basket holds before you buy.

positions.label: Positions
positions.title: Your positions
positions.description: Each position holds your baskets, loans, and Dollar together. Manage collateral, staking, and rewards from here.

loans.label: Loans
loans.title: Your loans
loans.description: Money you have borrowed against locked collateral. Review what you owe, what is locked, and when each loan is due.

rewards.label: Rewards
rewards.title: Your rewards
rewards.description: Stake a position to earn a share of protocol fees. Pick which assets to earn in and claim what you have built up.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.title: Provide liquidity
liquidity.description: Supply assets so other people can trade, and earn a share of the trading fees. Review your pools and what they have earned.

create.label: Launch policy
create.title: Basket launch policy
create.description: Public basket creation is closed during the testnet beta. Review how governed launches work and browse the baskets already available.

activity.label: Activity
activity.title: Your activity
activity.description: Every action from this wallet, from the moment you confirm it to the moment it settles.

tools.label: Tools
tools.title: Approval tools
tools.description: Review and revoke the permissions this wallet has granted to Statics.

shell.wrongNetworkTitle: You are on the wrong network.
shell.wrongNetworkBody: Statics data will not load until you switch to {network}.
shell.wrongNetworkBodyWithChain: Statics data will not load until you switch to {network} (chain {chainId}).

account.title: Your account
account.solanaMissing: No Solana wallet yet. One is created the first time you use a Solana route.
account.exportWarning: Exporting reveals recovery material that controls this wallet and every asset it holds. Never share it or paste it into a website, chat, or cloud note.

landing.eyebrow: The anchor is fixed. The market is not.
landing.heroDescription: Every basket is a fixed bundle, always redeemable for exactly what is inside it. No manager, no rebalancing, no liquidations. Markets move around that anchor — Statics pays the people who hold it steady.
landing.heroVisual: Digital marble statue of Robin Hood
landing.heroAlt: A fragmented digital marble statue of Robin Hood wearing a feathered cap and goatee
landing.basketsDescription: A fixed bundle of 1–16 assets, held as a single token. Redeem it any time for exactly what is inside — the same amounts, forever. No manager, no rebalancing, no discretion.
landing.dollarDescription: A dollar backed by collateral anyone can verify on-chain. Risk shares take losses first, so the dollar stays whole.
landing.ownPositionDescription: Baskets, loans, and dollar series live in one position you can hold, transfer, or sell as a single asset.
landing.noLiquidationsDescription: Debt is denominated in the same assets as the collateral, so a price crash moves both sides together. There is nothing to liquidate.
landing.deepLiquidityDescription: A share of every swap becomes permanent protocol-owned liquidity. Pools get deeper the more they trade, and that depth cannot be withdrawn.
landing.stakeEarnDescription: Stake and opt into up to 64 reward assets. Rewards are swap fees paid in kind — real revenue, not emissions.
landing.tagline: Fixed assets. Fixed rules. Everything else is free to move.
landing.redeemExactly: Redeem for exactly what is inside

position.label: Position
position.plain: Everything you hold in Statics, bundled into one transferable item.

basket.label: Basket
basket.plain: A fixed bundle of assets you can buy or sell as a single unit.

underlying.label: Underlying
underlying.plain: One of the assets a basket holds. A basket is worth what its underlyings are worth.

dollar.label: Dollar
dollar.plain: Statics' own dollar, backed by assets you deposit.

riskShares.label: Risk shares
riskShares.plain: The variable half of a deposit: it absorbs price moves so the Dollar stays stable.

collateral.label: Collateral
collateral.plain: Assets you lock up to back a Dollar balance or a loan.

loan.label: Loan
loan.plain: Money borrowed against collateral you have locked, repayable on its own schedule.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.plain: Assets you supply so other people can trade, earning you a share of the fees.

liquidityPosition.label: Liquidity position
liquidityPosition.plain: Your individual share of a trading pool.

tradingFees.label: Trading fees
tradingFees.plain: The cut taken on each trade in a pool, shared out to the people who supplied it.

protocolLiquidity.label: Protocol-owned liquidity
protocolLiquidity.plain: Liquidity the protocol holds permanently, rather than any individual person.

priceFeed.label: Price feed
priceFeed.plain: The live price the protocol uses to value your assets.

borrowLimit.label: Borrow limit
borrowLimit.plain: The most that can be borrowed against the collateral backing this profile.

health.label: Health
health.plain: How well covered your position is. Higher is safer.

rewards.label: Rewards
rewards.plain: Fees you have earned and can claim.

staking.label: Staking
staking.plain: Depositing Statics so it earns a share of protocol fees. It stays withdrawable.

earningDelay.label: Earning delay
earningDelay.plain: Newly staked funds start earning a little later. They are never locked up.

openToAnyone.label: Open to anyone
openToAnyone.plain: No approval or gatekeeper. Anyone can do this.
